server.name: community-memorix
server.note: Launched the way its registry entry says to (packageArguments: serve). It keeps its store in ~/.memorix, so HOME moves into the trial root and only the npm download cache points back at the real home.

observer.name: memorix-store
observer.note: revisionCount is ignored deliberately (preregistration 6.3). It is a monotonic counter, so it increments on a repeat whether or not the stored payload changes, and observing it would make any repeat read as duplicated regardless of effect. With it dropped, a repeat that leaves the payload identical is indistinguishable from one application, and the fixture is kept out of the duplicate denominator rather than counted as safe.
